dataset: The same 100 published held-out antibodies, all included; engineering fixtures excluded.
feature_mode: compact for all conditions, including strict controls; unlike the earlier dense strict diagnostic
implementation: One candidate module in every condition: point-matmul disabled for compilation-alone control, enabled for combined; unchanged accepted inference flags and weights.

precision.strict: highest, TF32 disabled before model load and compilation

comparison: Compare combined against compilation alone within the SAME precision; also show normal/strict absolute accuracy.
timing: Four warmed model passes, fixed B=16/N=272, 100 real targets plus 12 discarded dummy rows. Fresh offline container/cache per condition; reverse condition order for second checkpoint. Report first-forward/compilation latency separately.
memory: CUDA allocated/reserved peaks and sampled process-tree RSS, kept separate on unified memory.
accuracy: All six CDRs and frameworks, whole-Fv CA/BB RMSD, local CA lDDT, confidence, sidechain accuracy/torsions and geometric clash proxy. Reuse qualified scorers.
decision: Show all results before enabling either combination on dev; main unchanged.
